description: Edit this sheet of six small chibi pixel art figures sitting on the ground: in the top row one sits facing the viewer, one sits facing away from the viewer, one sits facing the viewer with the hands at the chest; in the bottom row one sits facing the viewer with the hands at the mouth and two sit facing away. Dress every figure in the same outfit and change nothing else: keep each figure's pose, size, place, bald head, ears and face exactly as they are, with the same chunky pixel size, the same thick dark outline and the same flat shading with a few tones per colour. The outfit: a red-and-black checked shirt, a brown leather vest, blue jeans with a big silver buckle belt and tan cowboy boots. Seen from behind: the back of the checked shirt and the brown leather vest, blue jeans and tan cowboy boots. Simple bold shapes, no fine pattern. Nothing of the outfit reaches lower than each seated figure's own lowest pixels, which stay exactly where they are. The hands stay bare and keep their place. Transparent background, nothing else added.
